prior_diagnostics: Read-only source inspection identified eager original-turn unit parsing for already accepted pages, full-turn projection scans, and duplicate final-context token encoding. No v032 performance candidate has been measured. Previous scored corpora are development/regression data.
preserve: all v0.3.1 and older tags, raw reports, bindings, rejected candidates and frozen evaluator files
lexical normalization, indexed text, BM25 weights, exact/stem routes, scope-before-LIMIT, route limits, ranking, novelty and temporal rules
Q2 model, vectors, indexing and fusion identity
complete valid-store non-timing payloads, source spans, strict character/token budgets, both tokenizers, default result-cache/MCP contracts
one SQLite source snapshot and documented source-coordinate corruption rejection behavior

performance_candidate.hypothesis: Avoid unused supplemental source-unit parsing after legacy first-fit decisions, narrow ordered unit projection with start-offset bisection, and reuse the exact token count of the final accepted context. Source reads remain in the original snapshot; source-coordinate validation behavior must be preserved. A bounded source-fetch batching change may be included only if profiling and fresh correctness fixtures support it.
allowed: one combined exact-output candidate selected before source/evaluator binding
lazy pure computation on captured original-turn text; no database read after the source transaction
start-offset bisection retaining all original containment/equality checks
bounded original-turn SQL reads keyed by both session and ordinal if development evidence supports them
forbidden: advertising development timing as formal performance

development.role: Old-data profiling, fresh artificial correctness fixtures and complete-payload regression only; choose one bounded combined implementation before formal freeze. Preserve each tried implementation hash and negative diagnostic result. No hidden candidate selection after formal timing.
fresh_fixtures: prefix token counts that are non-monotonic
long original turns with overlapping/nested complete units
CRLF/CJK/combining characters/emoji/literal special tokens and open/closed code fences
multiple sessions with identical turn ordinals

formal.query_order: random.Random(41061 + 1009 * round + config_index), equal for paired engines
formal.execution: Sequential isolated workers on the same machine with no concurrent benchmark. Warm OS/SQLite caches; no OS-cold-cache claim. Native has cache_size=0 and use_cache=False. Real SDK MCP clears persistent recall_cache before each call, including its normal cache-write cost; clearing is outside timing.
record: every per-query sample and complete payload hash
MCP text and actual envelope hash
p50/p95/mean for every cell and every round, pooled and first/repeat rounds
RSS/high-water RSS, logical and live DB/WAL/SHM size
both tokenizer counts computed outside timing
formal.gate: No complete non-timing payload mismatch or invariant failure. Across all twelve cohort/configuration cells, geometric-mean pooled p95 improves by at least 10%; at least one public native token-budget cell improves p95 by at least 15%; public actual-MCP token1024 improves p95 by at least 10%; no pooled cell p50 or p95 regresses by more than 5%. Retain all samples and rounds. A startup, ingestion, unchanged replay or RSS mean increase over 10% requires an explicit cause assessment and independent review, not replacement timing.
formal.failure_rule: If the sole bounded candidate fails correctness, fix a demonstrated implementation bug and retain the failed attempt. If a valid candidate misses the performance gate, report it and do not advertise or ship it as a measured speedup. No selecting the fastest run.

quality_candidate.reason: This release first targets exact-output efficiency. Residual-budget evidence expansion is an unscored future hypothesis, not a registered or shipped quality change.

freeze_before_selection: exact baseline/candidate commits and runtime hashes
all new and reused evaluator files
packages, model artifacts and upstream locks

cohort.name: round4-hotpot256
cohort.selection: Sort SHA256(prefix + ID) then ID; exclude all original Hotpot128, round2 Hotpot256 and round3 Hotpot256 IDs. Read only upstream IDs for selection; no outcome/content filtering. Same source, not new-domain evidence.

native.gate: Complete default payload equivalence and strict source/scope/character/token invariants. Preserve every Q2 gain and loss; Q2 is unchanged and optional.

components.projection: Six common whole-block projections from each first response. No extra search for diagnostic packing. Preserve actual native/adapter/read costs, complete payload/text/reference-token surfaces, startup/indexing/download/RSS/storage, and source hashes. Compare fixed verified upstream revisions; no whole-product speed ratio.

independent_validation.compatibility: Q2 source remains unchanged; tokenized Q2 output must match the v031 implementation on old authored36 and Hotpot128 with the same persisted vectors/model. Explicit coverage and source snapshot fixtures also remain compatible.
independent_validation.interpretation: All previously scored selections are regression data. New IDs become regression data after first scoring. No generated-answer or private-conversation-generalization claim.

durability: Commit this protocol before development measurements; commit candidate/evaluator binding before formal execution. Each hosted worker or stage publishes immutable raw results and its start/finish ledger before advancing. Use new round4 paths and execution claims, exact refs, non-force writes and Git object reuse. Preserve interrupted workers and all failures. Never repeat a completed formal run to choose better samples.
release: Only a candidate that passes fixed correctness, performance and validation gates may ship as v0.3.2. Preserve prior tags. Pin package/installers, document gains and costs, require nine exact-commit CI jobs and all seven public assets plus real URL installation verification.
